scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:js -- --fix && npm run lint:css -- --fix
scripts.build:lenis: mkdir -p deps/lenis/dist && esbuild --format=esm --minify ./deps/lenis/src/index.js --bundle --outfile=./deps/lenis/dist/index.js && cp node_modules/lenis/dist/lenis.css deps/lenis/dist/lenis.css
scripts.build:c2pa: rm -rf deps/c2pa-web && mkdir -p deps/c2pa-web/resources && esbuild node_modules/@contentauth/c2pa-web/dist/index.js --format=esm --bundle --outfile=deps/c2pa-web/index.js && cp node_modules/@contentauth/c2pa-web/dist/c2pa_worker.js deps/c2pa-web/c2pa_worker.js && cp node_modules/@contentauth/c2pa-web/dist/resources/c2pa_bg.wasm deps/c2pa-web/resources/c2pa_bg.wasm
